name: Aldeanueva del Camino (Spain)
description: Divided by a white diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, red at the hoist and yellow at the fly.
history: The arms and the flag of Aldeanueva del Camino were approved by the Order of 2 June 1993 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 15 June 1993, after the municipal council's approval on 30 June 1992; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, composed of a white diagonal stripe from the lower hoist corner to the upper fly, the hoist triangle red and the fly triangle yellow.

features.role: band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
